'''Bardo Verwen''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] in the [[Tobali system]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tor (star)|Tor]]. It separated the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var's]] orbit taking its course on the side closest to the [[Star/Legends|sun]], and the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] of the system had orbits on the far side of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt.
